svg.text: One blank folded into a wall with a foot and two side flanges.

svg.text: Wall 92 mm wide x 72 mm tall; foot 27 mm deep; side flanges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 27 mm deep, 50 mm tall. Relieve the corners with 3 mm holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plug notch in the wall, open at the top: 60 mm wide, down to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 mm above the tray. The pack's plug passes through it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: foot two 5.5 mm, 13 mm from the wall, 20 mm each side;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each flange two 5.5 mm, 7 and 19 mm from the wall, 25 mm up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
